capabilities: Publish and unpublish notes to Quaily channels
Generate post summaries and tags with AI
Preview posts on mobile devices or desktop browsers
extras: Full usage documentation is hosted externally on Quaily's docs site; the README mostly links to it and shows screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to an external newsletter/blog publishing service like Quaily.

relations.evidence: This is a plugin for Quaily.com, a publishing service

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to Quaily.com as blog posts or newsletters, and can deliver them to subscribers.
